transcription: okay, good morning good morning doctor okay, what is your name? Elijah Samuel Okay, how old are you? I am 28. okay so, kí ló gbé ẹ wà sì hospital lónìí? I came to complain about abdominal pain. okay, how long have you been having this abdominal pain? four days ago. okay, ṣé ó kó déédéé bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní àbí díẹ̀ díẹ̀ ní ó bẹ̀rẹ̀? ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ díẹ̀ díẹ̀. okay, so can you describe this pain? ati ìbò lọ tí bẹrẹ? Ṣé àti òkè ikùn ní tàbí àti ìsàlẹ̀ ikùn? àti oke ìkún ní ó ti bẹ̀rẹ̀. okay, so nígbàtí ó yà, ó wá move sì ìsàlẹ̀ ìkún ní apá ọ̀tún. okay so, this pain is it sharp? No sir. is it dull? no sir. is it aching? yes sir. on a scale of 1-10, 1 is the lowest pain you have ever felt in your life. 10 is the highest pain you have ever felt in your life. Not pale, anicteric, febrile with a temperature of 38 degrees centigrade, respiratory rate 12 cycles per minute, SpO2 98% in room air, pulse rate 90 beats per minute, BP 120/80. ​On abdominal examination, there is right iliac fossa tenderness. Um, there's guarding. There is, um, rebound tenderness in the right iliac fossa. Positive Rovsing and McBurney sign. ​Um, so the truth is, I might give you, place you on some antibiotics. We might try a conservative management to help reduce the pain, pain reliever and antibiotics. But if it's not getting better, the main stay of treatment is surgery, which is the appendectomy, to remove the appendix the inflamed appendix. Also we might do an abdominal scan, pelvic ultrasound scan to rule out other pathologies.

transcription: okay good morning good morning doctor kíni orúkọ yín? Òkè owó Suleiman ọmọ ọdún mélòó niyin? 27 years old ìgbà wo ní è pé 27? January 2nd okay, that's good so what brought you to the hospital today? I came to complain cough okay, so how long have you been coughing? since two days ago okay ikọ yìí ṣe ó kàn déédéé bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní tàbí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ díẹ̀ díẹ̀? okay so ti ẹ bá ń wú kò yìí ṣe ẹ má ń notice pé tí ẹ bá wù ikọ kan ń si, kí ẹ tó wuko mí, ẹ má need láti catch breathe yín exactly okay so ikọ yìí tí ẹ bá ń wú ṣe nǹkan kan má ń bota? rara okay, ṣe ẹ notice pé tí ẹ bá ń wú kò náà bóyá ẹ máa ń notice pẹ ẹjẹ̀ má ń bota? no kó sí ẹ̀jẹ̀ okay, is there any particular time of the day that this cough is usually worse yes tó bá di alẹ́ mọ òru okay, so ṣe atẹgun tí ó ń fẹ́ ṣe ó ti poju ní kí ẹ tó máa wuko yìí? so tí ikọ yìí bati bẹ̀rẹ̀ do you notice that you have difficulty breathing? yes, exactly okay do you notice that you tend to, there's a wheezing sound that you can produce, it's called ó má má dùn bí hun,hunhun ṣe ẹ má ń notice pé ẹ má ń produce irú sound be yẹn bẹẹni sir okay, do you use carpet at home or rug? carpet okay, how long have you been using this carpet? since I moved to my house. okay, when did you move to this house? A year plus now okay, that's good, okay is there any medication you're using currently? yes, I use ibuprofen for my leg pain okay how lọng have you been having this leg pain? since three days ago. okay kíni ẹ fi ẹsẹ ṣe? mo ṣubú nínú ilé nani before this cough started or in the course of this cough ṣe ẹ notice pé bóyá ẹ ní catarrh? rara sir okay, ṣe ẹ notice pé bóyá àrà yín má ń gbóná bóyá láró, ọ̀sán tàbí lálẹ́ maybe you tend to feel this cold, this fever-like feeling? not at all is there, in the recent times, maybe in the last two weeks or last one week has there been any contact with anybody tí ó ń wuko gidi gan-an? no okay, in recent times have you travelled to anywhere? no sìr okay, is there any medication tí ó jé wípé tí ẹ bá jẹ bóyá ẹwà allergic sì tí ó jé wípé tí ẹ bá jẹ o má gbodi lára yín? either food either drugs, is there anything like that? yes, I am allergic to dust yàtò sì dust kíni ẹ tún wà allergic sì? nut is there any family history of allergies too? yes okay, so what are they allergic to? saw mill dust Okay, no problem, thank you. ​On examination, I found a young man, not pale, anicteric, acyanosed, not dehydrated. ​Temperature on presentation was 37 °C. Respiratory rate was 12 cycles per minute. SpO2 in room air is 97%. Pulse rate, 70 beats per minute. BP 120/80 mmHg. ​On chest examination, I noticed there were widespread rhonchi in all zones of the lungs. ​So, mo ma need kí ẹ ṣe àwọn àyẹ̀wò kan. Mo ma need kí ẹ ṣe àyẹ̀wò ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí wọn ń pè ní full blood count. O ma wò infection nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ yin. ​ Then mo ma need ki ẹ ṣe àwọn àyẹ̀wò chest X-ray so that ma lè mọ̀ nǹkan tí ẹ ni gangan. Bóyá asthma ni, bóyá TB ni. So mo need láti mọ̀, ṣé ẹ̀ ń gbọ́? ​ ​ Then, àyẹ̀wò kan náà wà tí ẹ ma need láti ṣe. Mi ò mọ̀ bóyá á lè wà ní àyiká yìí. It's called spirometry, so what it does basically is that it helps to measure your lung functions. Okay, no problem, thank you.

Before we get there, afa olee ka ịdị? Adi m 27 years Ok. Gịnị ka i na-arụ ugbua? A bu m nwa akwụkwọ. Ok. Ị lụọ la di? Maọbu yea, ịlụ ọ la di? Mba... Ok. I na-ekpe chọọchị ka I na-ekpe mosque? A wu m a Christian. Nsogbụ adirọ and I wu onye Igbo now? Ok. So, ụkwara now, kee mgbe o bido? Ọ nwanne echi (2 days ago). Ok. O nwee ihe na-aputa mgbe I na-akwa ụkwara? Mba... Ok. The ụkwara, does it come very frequently? No... Ok. Is it better during the day or worse during the day or at night? Ọ na-adi njọ n'abali Ok, ok. Does it allow you to breathe well? No no no, I don't breathe well. A naghị m eku ume. Ọ na-aria ma ahụ ịkụ ume. Ok, nsogbụ adirọ. Ok, I na-enwe ahụ ọkụ? Mba... Ok. Gị na mmadụ na-akwa ụkwara, ịhụ la onye ọbula na-akwa ụkwara recently? Mba.. Ok. I mee travel recently? M na-akwa ụkwara, ọ na-eme noise. Ok, ok, have you travelled recently? Mba... Ọ nwee ihe ọbula I na-ata maybe I na-enwe reaction to that thing? Yea, yea. M taa nut, m taa nut ihe dịka cashew nut maọbu groundnut, ọ na-enye m nsogbụ. Ok. N'ezi na ụlọ gị, ọ nwere onye nwe ihe a na-eme? Ọ gaa abụ nut but onwe anything, onwe onye this kind thing na-eme? Mma m. Ọ na-eme mma m Ok, ok. Okuba ya, ọ na-enye ya nsogbụ Ok. Nsogbụ adirọ . Ụlọ gị now, I na e use tiles maọbu carpet ka ọ rug? Ọ carpet. Ok. Ọ nwee any drug I na e take now? Ee, e nwere. Ụkwụ na-egbu m mgbu, so a na m añu ibuprofen maka ụkwụ ahụ na-egbu m mgbu. Ok. Nsogbụ adirọ. Ọ nwere ọrịa ọzọ I na-aria n'ahụ gị dịka ulcer maọbu diabetes? Mba, mba Ok, nsogbụ adirọ. A ga m ele gị, a ga m ele ahụ gị ugbu a ka m mara na ahụ gị ọ dị ọkụ. Then, I will also listen to your chest, ok? Okay. Alright, so from everything you've told me and me listening to your chest, e nwere ihe m nụrụ na your chest, a na-akpọ ya Rhonchi. So, from that rhonchi now m nụrụ and this cough and ihe ọbula a I gwara m, I'm suspecting na I nwee ihe a na-akpọ Asthma. Now, that asthma now, ọ ga na-enye gị nsogbụ mgbe ọbula if you're exposed to things like dust or smoke or cold ok? You'll be reacting excessively and it'll be causing you problems. So, ihe a ga-eme nwụ, ọ nwere one test ikwesiri ime, a na-akpọ ya Pulmonary Function Test Okay. I ga-eme that test. Anyị ga eji ya wee confirm ọ na I nwee Asthma. Ma, now ma I nwee Asthma, anyị ga enye gị ihe a na-akpọ inhaler. That inhaler now, ọ dịka, ọ just, ọ nwụ ọgwụ in short. So, I ga na-agba ya na-agba ya n'ọnụ gi mgbe ọbula I na-enwe this problem Okay. Then, you'll also be staying away from your triggers, all those triggers that I told you about like: cold, dusts and you may need to always keep your environment clean to prevent exposure to that dusts, okay? Ok Then, mgbe ọbula I ga na-abịa ụlọ ọgwụ maọbu na inwee any problem Okay. Nsogbụ adirọ. Thank you very much for coming, o? Thank you doctor, thank you o? God bless you

transcription: Good morning ma and welcome to our clinic today My name na Dr. Arangsomwa and na me go dey attend to you today. So, wetin be your name madam? I'm Agnes Okoro Okay Mrs. Agnes welcome. How old are you, ma? I'm 58 years. Okay what do you do for work ma? I dey work for traffic I dey help for dis traffic warden Okay so you be traffic warden yes Alright ma so you don marry? Yeah am married. Okay any children? Yes Okay ma Okay, which address you dey stay ? I dey stay for 44 Ogbaloba Street, Ekpe. Okay You be Christian, Muslim or which religion you dey practice? I be christian Okay which tribe you dey from? I be Igbo ooo Alright Okay thank you very much ma. So what brings you to the hospital today? Um, I dey feel this knee pain na why I come here come reports Okay you say you dey feel this knee pain. This knee pain wey you dey feel, when e start? About two, yeah, two weeks ago. Okay do you noticed it on both knees? Yes yes Okay E first start for the right knee before e now move to the left one Okay, okay. How e take start? Shey e just start suddenly abi you start to dey notice am over some time? it was suddenly, just suddenly it just starts. Okay dis pain we dey do you, how you go describe the pain? Is it aching? Is it peppery? Is it itchy? Is it burning? Is aching yes the pain is aching always paining okay I say make you score this pain on a scale of 0 to 10 . 0 means say e no dey pain you at all 10 means say, the pain dey very, very, very painful say you no feel hold am Which score you go give am? I go give am like 6/10 Okay alright sorry about that so You get any other part of your body wey dey pain you? Okay. You get anything wey you dey do wey dey make dis pain worse? Dey always worse when I dey Waka l I dey work or I dey run that's when the pain becomes intense Okay you get anything wey you dey do wey dey give you any form of relief? No Okay. Shey e get anytime of the day wey dis pain dey worse ? Yes, for early morning morning time. Okay alright sorry about that ma Okay do you hear any cracking sounds maybe when you move your knee? Not frequently, just occasionally. Okay okay You fall, you use dat leg fall or something hit you for dat leg? No Okay you notice any swelling or say your leg no dey as it take be before? No no no Okay have you noticed any redness over the area of your knee? No Okay alright ma so have you noticed any fever? No No Okay any headache? No Okay since wen dis pain start e get any drug wey you dey use? I use, I dey use ibu Ibuprofen? Ibuprofen Yes Okay Has that been helpful? Little relief Okay alright ma so you get hypertension before dey don ever tell you say your BP go high? Yes. Okay na how many years you don get dis hypertension? 10 years now. Okay so you get any drug wey you dey use? Dem prescribe Amlodipine so na wetin I dey use everytime be dat okay so dis amlodipine wey you dey use shey na 5 milligram or 10 milligrams 10 10 mg Okay you dey always check your BP every day for house Yes Okay like wetin e dey always read? Sometimes 120/80, sometimes 130/70. Okay alright do you drink or smoke ma? No, I don't. Okay are you diabetic? No, I'm not. Okay, do you have ulcer? No. Okay, so you no dey drink alcohol at all? No I don't take alcohol And you no dey smoke? Okay what of herbs all dis agbo you dey always dey take those ones ? I dey take dat one once in a while sha not everytime Okay alright say you get any other thing wey you want complain about? No. Okay so on examination, she's conscious, she's not in obvious painful distress. She's afebrile with a temperature of 37.2 degrees Celsius She's not pale, she's anicteric, she's acynosed, she's not dehydrated. Her blood pressure na 120/80 millimeters of mercury. Her heart rate now 90 beats per minute. Her height na 1.56 meters and her weight na 70 kg On musculoskeletal examination, there were no obvious swellings or deformities. There was mild tenderness On the knees, bilaterally with crepitations and also reduced range of motion. So madam, based on these questions wey we don ask you and all the questions wey we don ask you, we get feeling say the likely diagnosis na arthritis, wetin we dey call osteoarthritis. So but to confirm the diagnosis and to rule out other differentials, we go like do some tests So I go send you now, you go go do some particular blood tests. Some of these blood tests include full blood count, some include some antibodies, wey go really help us know if na really osteoarthritis you get. Then you go also do X-rays of the knee, wey we see the knee wey dey pain you wella. Okay So after that, you come back to us and the treatment we will be able to give you both treatments that involve drugs and the ones that don't involve drugs. The ones that don't involve drugs will be more with exercises and some therapy that you can use, while the ones that involve drugs will be mostly for the around pain relief. So do you have any question now ? no I don't Doctor Alright, so thank you very much for your timeand bye-bye ma

Mimi sijui mbona nimeletwa hospitali.Ni familia yangu tu naona wanao verreact sana. Okay, your family says umekuwa uki behave differently. Can you tell me nini imekuwa ikiendelea? Exactly. Mimi hakuna kitu mbaya na mimi. It's just watu hawanielewi mimi. Umekosana na watu wa familia? Of course. Wanaona wanaingilia sana. Na, izi shida, when did they start? Kitu kama three weeks ago ivi. Na, did they start suddenly ama they started gradually? Hapo nayo mimi sijui.Nilijipata tu watu wenye wako around me wana nikasirikia bure. Okay. Na, ni nini ili happen just before mambo yaanze kuwa ivo? What I can say ni ati I was spending a lot of time with my friends.Where were you guys hanging out? Just going to clubs. Ulikuwa unatoka saa ngapi kwa izo clubs? Si, you know the trend ukienda club . Masaa tu huisha bila we kujua, so utatoka tu usiku usiku ivi. I see. And have you become aggressive recently? Sometimes. Kuna watu naona ni kama they want to kill me.You feel like there are people who want to kill you? Exactly. Watu wagani hao? I do not know them, but nashuku wananifuata tu kila mahali. Najua tu hawanitaki vizuri. Na saa zingine unaona vitu zenye watu wengine hawaoni? Taimali, nimeona some strange things zikinifuata. Na ziko around me. Mimi huwa napenda vodka, iyo ndo inanifuraisha zaidi. And how often do you take it? Na si almost every day. Na sigara, unatumia sigara? Natumia pia sigara. Unatumia ngapi? Iyo nayo siezi kuambia juu sihesabu. Ningependa kujua zaidi kuhusu venye umekua. Haina shida. Okay, have you been admitted before because of mental illness? No. Have you seen a psychiatrist before? Apana pia. Do you have any other illness? I do not have any other illness. Have you had any surgical procedures done before? Yes, I've had a surgery been done. Walienda wakatoa appendix yangu. When was that? Two years ago. Alafu, do you have any drugs ama chakula yote yenye ukikula, ama ukikunywa yenye inakuharibikia? Apana. Na mtu yeyote kwa familia mwenye amewai kuwa na shida kama yako? Apana, ni mimi peke yangu wamenisumbua. There are some questions I'd like to ask ili nielewe your mental state, is that okay? It is fine.Okay, thank you. How are you feeling today? I'm fine. How would you describe your mood? Mood yangu iko tu sawa. I will say I'm fine. Na recently, nini umekuwa ukifikiria sana sana? I've been thinking of many things sana. Unajua there are many plans that I have. Nataka kufungua biashara, nataka kununua gari, nataka kutafuta pia bibi, sina. Nataka izo vitu zote. Sasa izo ndiyo nimekuwa nikifikiria. Do you still feel like there are people who want to harm you? Si nilikuambia kuna watu wanataka kuniua. There are people who want to kill me. Na saa zingine unaskia kama watu wanaeza jua fikra zako? Siku hizi ata I fear thinking sana because I think people can read whatever I think. Na currently, unaeza sema unaskia sauti zozote? Hapana, currently there is nothing that I'm hearing lakini there are some times which I hear, venye tu nimekuambia. Na kuona anything yenye si ya kawaida? Hapana, currently no, but it happens sometimes. Na saa hizi as we speak, where are you? We are in hospital. Na do you think you have any mental illness? Mimi, I'm fine. I don't think I have any issue.It's just that my family, they are not planning good things with me na they are not understanding. Personally, I feel I'm just good and you should let me go. We are going to take a urine sample and a blood sample, alafu unilete majibu. Okay. Anything that makes me go home early. Okay. Thank you. Thank you.

transcription: Good morning. Good morning, to you too. How are you today? I'm doing good.I am Dr. Wamutende and I will be attending to you today. Good to know you, Daktari. Can you tell me your name and your age? Mimi ni James. I am 25 years old. Na, James, unajua mbona umeletwa hospitali? Hapana. Mimi sijui mbona nimeletwa hospitali.Ni familia yangu tu naona wanao verreact sana. Okay, your family says umekuwa uki behave differently. Can you tell me nini imekuwa ikiendelea? Exactly. Mimi hakuna kitu mbaya na mimi. It's just watu hawanielewi mimi. Umekosana na watu wa familia? Of course. Wanaona wanaingilia sana. Na, izi shida, when did they start? Kitu kama three weeks ago ivi. Na, did they start suddenly ama they started gradually? Hapo nayo mimi sijui.Nilijipata tu watu wenye wako around me wana nikasirikia bure. Okay. Na, ni nini ili happen just before mambo yaanze kuwa ivo? What I can say ni ati I was spending a lot of time with my friends.Where were you guys hanging out? Just going to clubs. Ulikuwa unatoka saa ngapi kwa izo clubs? Si, you know the trend ukienda club . Masaa tu huisha bila we kujua, so utatoka tu usiku usiku ivi. I see. And have you become aggressive recently? Sometimes. Especially wakati gani? Watu wakianza kuniingilia na kuniuliza maswali zenye hazinifurahishi. And will you say that you feel uko safe around people? Hapana, no, not really. Why? Kuna watu naona ni kama they want to kill me.You feel like there are people who want to kill you? Exactly. Watu wagani hao? I do not know them, but nashuku wananifuata tu kila mahali. Alafu, kuna circumstances zenye una feel ni kama unasikia vitu zenye watu wengine hawajaskia? Yes, there are scenarios mahali nasikia watu ni kama wananiongelelea.Na unasikia kama wana nasema nini? Najua tu hawanitaki vizuri. Na saa zingine unaona vitu zenye watu wengine hawaoni? Taimali, nimeona some strange things zikinifuata. Na ziko around me. Na umejaribu kuliza watu wengine kama wanaziona? Niliuliza. Others wanasema ni kama hizo vitu naona haziko. And how have you been sleeping? My sleep, huwa I don't sleep well. Nashindwa kulala. Na nikilala naamka mara kadhaa sana usiku. How about your appetite? Appetite iko aje? These days I have a very big appetite. Nakula sana. Unakula more than usual? Yes, sana sana. Na on your typical day, nini huwa unafanya? I don't lack anything to do. Vitu ni mingi za kufanya. Na kutulia unatulia? Hapana, natulia mbona. Nguvu iko kwa wingi. And I've been told that umekunywa methylated spirit. Can you tell me about that? Iyo nayo nilikunywa. Na unaona shida yoyote na iyo? Na shida gani? Mimi sioni anything significant na iyo? Na unatumia sigara, pombe, ama bangi? Unatumia gani? Izo zote zenye umesema. Kama sasa iyo bangi, unatumia aje? Inategemea, but natumia kitu kama, around six packs ivi. Kila siku? Kila siku. Umekuwa ukitumia for how long? Unafanya fanya iyo for some time, iyo naielewa. I see. And what of alcohol? Pombe nayo pia, natumia tumia. Unakunywa type gani? Mimi huwa napenda vodka, iyo ndo inanifuraisha zaidi. And how often do you take it? Na si almost every day. Na sigara, unatumia sigara? Natumia pia sigara. Unatumia ngapi? Iyo nayo siezi kuambia juu sihesabu. Ningependa kujua zaidi kuhusu venye umekua. Haina shida. Okay, have you been admitted before because of mental illness? No. Have you seen a psychiatrist before? Apana pia. Do you have any other illness? I do not have any other illness. Have you had any surgical procedures done before? Yes, I've had a surgery been done. Walienda wakatoa appendix yangu. When was that? Two years ago. Alafu, do you have any drugs ama chakula yote yenye ukikula, ama ukikunywa yenye inakuharibikia? Apana. Na mtu yeyote kwa familia mwenye amewai kuwa na shida kama yako? Apana, ni mimi peke yangu wamenisumbua. There are some questions I'd like to ask ili nielewe your mental state, is that okay? It is fine.Okay, thank you. How are you feeling today? I'm fine. How would you describe your mood? Mood yangu iko tu sawa. I will say I'm fine. Na recently, nini umekuwa ukifikiria sana sana? I've been thinking of many things sana. Unajua there are many plans that I have. Nataka kufungua biashara, nataka kununua gari, nataka kutafuta pia bibi, sina. Nataka izo vitu zote. Sasa izo ndiyo nimekuwa nikifikiria. Do you still feel like there are people who want to harm you? Si nilikuambia kuna watu wanataka kuniua. There are people who want to kill me. Na saa zingine unaskia kama watu wanaeza jua fikra zako? Siku hizi ata I fear thinking sana because I think people can read whatever I think. Na currently, unaeza sema unaskia sauti zozote? Hapana, currently there is nothing that I'm hearing lakini there are some times which I hear, venye tu nimekuambia. Na kuona anything yenye si ya kawaida? Hapana, currently no, but it happens sometimes. Na saa hizi as we speak, where are you? We are in hospital. Na do you think you have any mental illness? Mimi, I'm fine. I don't think I have any issue.It's just that my family, they are not planning good things with me na they are not understanding. Personally, I feel I'm just good and you should let me go. Do you feel like you need any treatment? Hapana, mimi sihitaji yoyote. So, James, kuna vipimo nataka ufanyiwe alafu uniletee majibu. We are going to take a urine sample and a blood sample, alafu unilete majibu. Okay. Anything that makes me go home early. Okay. Thank you. Thank you.

transcription: Good morning. Good morning to you too. How are you today? I am doing fine, thank you. Welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. Peninnah. Thank you, Dr. Peninnah, and it's nice to meet you today. I am Njoroge from Kimbo, Ruiru. How old are you? I am 35 years of age. How can I help you today? Daktari, I am not feeling well. I have been having a cough. For how long? Kwa muda wa miezi 3. Huo ni muda mrefu sana. Na imekuwa na kikohozi? Kikohozi inatoka. Ya rangi gani? It's yellow in colour, na ni mzito sana. Na iko na damu? Actually, I have noticed occasionally some blood kwa kikohozi, kwa kikohozi. Kuna masaa unakohoa zaidi kushinda masaa mengine ya usiku? Hapana. Kuna anything yenye ina worsen that cough? There is nothing that I can think of. Una sweat sana usiku? Ku sweat nayo na sweat sana hadi naamka napata mavazi imejaa maji. Na uko na joto mwilini? Joto? Joto nimekuwa nayo kwa muda wa miezi, karibia mwezi moja ivi. Iyo joto ni nyingi ama kidogo? Mingi naona. Kifua inakuuma? Naumwa nayo. Kifua nayo inaniuma.Ilianza aje iyo uchungu? Ilianza polepole alafu ikaongezeka . Na uchungu ni zaidi wakati gani? When I cough, I feel more pain, na pia nikikohoa. Umepoteza kilo? Kilo nimepoteza. Venye nilipima hivi last month na venye nimepima leo, nimeona kuna tofauti. And how is your appetite? Hamu ya chakula imenipotea. Nala kidogo kushinda kawaida. Na daktari, naskia pia uchungu na sina nguvu ya kufanya my daily activities. And do you boil your milk before drinking? Yes, I always confirm that I boil my milk before I take it. Alafu ukiwa mtoto, did you receive the BCG vaccine? I am not sure about that. Umesafiri of late ? Yes, I have actually recently travelled for work reasons. Na umekaa karibu na mtu yeyote ambaye amekuwa akikohoa for a while? Okay, now that I have recently travelled, nilipata someone who I share a room with, and he has also been having this cough. And have you used any drugs, kama antibiotics? I have not used any drugs so far. Nikuulize, umewai lazwa hospitalini? Sijalazwa hospitalini. Have you had any surgeries done, whether major or minor? I ahev also, I haven't had any surgeries. What of transfusions, have you received any blood? No transfusion has been done. Do you have any allergies to medication? I don't have any allergies to any medications. And have you been treated for TB before? I have not been treated for TB before. And concerning your family, are you married? I am not married. Do you have any kids? I don't have any kids. Nyumbani unaishi na nani? Naishi peke yangu. Na travel sana so there’s no constant place that I live, but I live alone. You travel for work? Yes, I travel for work reasons. Do you take alcohol? Not as often. I only take alcohol during social events. And do you smoke? I do smoke. How many cigarettes do you smoke in a day, if you can make an estimation? Roughly 10 cigarettes per day. And for how many years have you been smoking? I can approximate it at roughly 10 years. And what do you do for work? I am a carpenter. And has anyone in your family been treated for TB before? No, there is no one in my family who has been treated for TB. And have you received any herbal concussions before? I occasionally take some herbal concussions. Do you have medical insurance? I do not have medical insurance, but I am working on it. Have you had any neck pains, ama kuumwa na kichwa? No. Na kukojoa, unakojoa sawa? Is there any pain, any blood in the urine, or difficulty in passing urine? I also haven't experienced such. Na shida zozote za tumbo uko nazo kama vomiting, diarrhea, constipation? Tumbo nayo iko sawa. Tumbo iko sawa kabisa? Thank you for the information. Sasa nataka nikutume. I want you to do a chest X-ray and then uniletee majibu. Thank you Daktari for your time. You are welcome.
